sources.source:
grammar oracle.AuthoredNoEcoreImport.Tokens hidden(WS)
terminal ID: ('a'..'z'|'A'..'Z')+; terminal WS: (' '|'\t'|'\r'|'\n')+;

grammar oracle.TerminalReturnChange.Child with org.eclipse.xtext.common.Terminals
generate model "urn:intersect:inference:terminals:terminal_return_change"
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Model: count=INT; @Override terminal INT returns ecore::EString: ('0'..'9')+;

grammar oracle.ThreeLevelTerminal.Middle with org.eclipse.xtext.common.Terminals
terminal WORD: 'word';

grammar oracle.ThreeLevelScalar.Middle with org.eclipse.xtext.common.Terminals
Text: ID ('.' ID)*;
